groups.title: Air Nation
groups.def: Tenzin's Air Nation community: Tenzin, his wife Pema (an Air Acolyte) and their children Jinora, Ikki and Meelo, plus Bumi, Kai and Opal, who join after gaining airbending in Book Three. Zaheer, Korra, Katara and Kya are not members, nor is the family's bison Oogi; because Kya helps train the new airbenders in Book Three and Oogi is the Air Nation's bison, this group avoids Waterbenders, Animal Companions and Voiced by Dee Bradley Baker.

groups.title: Korra's Team Avatar
groups.def: Korra's Team Avatar: the four who form it in "When Extremes Meet" (Korra, Mako, Bolin, Asami) and its animal members Naga and Pabu. Allies who travel with them for a few episodes (Tenzin, Jinora, Lin, Varrick, Zhu Li and others) are not members, and Katara, Toph and Zuko were in Aang's Team Avatar.

groups.title: Waterbenders
groups.def: Every character shown waterbending in the show, Korra included: Katara (healing), Amon ("Endgame"), Tarrlok, Tahno, Tonraq, Unalaq, Desna, Eska, Ming-Hua, Kya, Hasook (the Fire Ferrets' first waterbender) and Viper ("Welcome to Republic City", "The Sting"). Senna is a waterbender only in press material and Shady Shin only in the Republic City Hustle web shorts (on TV Mako just offers to get "his bending back"), so this group avoids Triple Threat Triad and Married.

groups.title: Firebenders
groups.def: Every firebender in the show, Korra included: characters shown firebending (Mako, General Iroh, Zuko, P'Li with her combustion, Zolt at Amon's rally, Zuko's dragon Druk in "In Harm's Way") plus Uncle Iroh, the original series' firebender, who appears here only as a spirit.

groups.title: Earthbenders
groups.def: Every character shown earthbending in the show, Korra included; metalbending and lavabending count (Huan metalbends his sculptures, Aiwei his stairs; Bolin and Ghazan lavabend). Baatar Jr., Wu and Hou-Ting never bend and Opal is an airbender.

groups.title: Red Lotus
groups.def: Named members of the Red Lotus shown in the show: Zaheer, P'Li, Ming-Hua and Ghazan, the spy Aiwei, and Unalaq, revealed as a former member in "The Stakeout".

groups.title: Metal Clan
groups.def: Members of Suyin's Metal Clan in Zaofu at any point: Suyin, her children Baatar Jr., Huan, Opal, Wei and Wing, her adviser Aiwei and her former guard captain Kuvira. Varrick and Zhu Li take refuge in Zaofu in Book Three (Varrick runs its technology department), so they are borderline and this group avoids their groups Married, Industrialists and Engaged during the show; Team Avatar and Lin only visit.

groups.title: Beifong Family
groups.def: Toph Beifong and her blood descendants: her daughters Lin and Suyin and Suyin's children Baatar Jr., Huan, Opal, Wei and Wing. Kuvira was raised by Suyin "like a daughter" but is not "an official member of our family" (Baatar Jr., "The Coronation"), so she is left out and this group avoids her groups Heads of State, Earth Empire, Main villain of a Book and Engaged during the show.

groups.title: Republic City Police
groups.def: Officers or chiefs of the Republic City Police in the show: chiefs Toph (Book One flashbacks), Lin and Saikhan, and Mako, a detective from Book Two on. Korra only joins Tarrlok's task force, and Bolin joins the force only in the post-series Turf Wars comics.

groups.title: Married
groups.def: Characters shown or stated on screen to be married, widowed included: Tenzin and Pema, Tonraq and Senna, Varrick and Zhu Li (wed in the finale), Suyin (husband Baatar), Raiko (wife Buttercup), Katara (Aang's widow) and Hiroshi (his wife was killed). Unalaq, Zuko and Uncle Iroh have children but no spouse is ever mentioned, and Senna is a waterbender only in press material, so this group avoids their groups; Toph never married (Suyin: "Neither of us knew our fathers").

groups.title: Metalbenders
groups.def: Every character shown metalbending in the show, Korra included ("the first metalbending Avatar", Book Three): Lin, Toph (Book One flashbacks), Saikhan, Suyin, Kuvira, Huan (his sculptures), Wei and Wing, and Aiwei ("The Terror Within"). Bolin never manages it; Ghazan lavabends only.

groups.title: Heads of State
groups.def: Characters who lead a nation, tribe or self-governing city in or before the show: Earth Queen Hou-Ting, King Wu (crowned in "The Coronation"), President Raiko, Water Tribe chiefs Unalaq, Tonraq, Desna and Eska, Suyin (Zaofu), Kuvira (made provisional head of the Earth Kingdom), former Fire Lord Zuko, and Tenzin, head of the Air Nation, whom Bolin counts among "the other leaders" at Wu's coronation. Council members like Tarrlok, police chiefs and Amon don't count.

groups.title: Children of Aang's Team Avatar
groups.def: Children of members of Aang's original Team Avatar: Aang and Katara's Tenzin, Bumi and Kya, and Toph's daughters Lin and Suyin. Zuko's daughter Izumi isn't in this file (General Iroh is his grandson) and no children of Sokka or Suki appear.

groups.title: Earth Empire
groups.def: Characters who serve Kuvira's Earth Empire in Book Four: Kuvira, her fiance Baatar Jr., and Bolin, Varrick and Zhu Li, who work for her before defecting. Its prisoners (Suyin's family) and enemies don't count.

groups.title: Spirits
groups.def: Spirits in the show: Raava, Vaatu and Bumi's companion Bum-Ju, plus Uncle Iroh, who lives in the Spirit World as a spirit after his death. Humans who merge with or visit spirits (Korra, Unalaq as the Dark Avatar, Jinora) don't count. Bum-Ju looks like an animal companion, so this group avoids Animal Companions.

groups.title: Triple Threat Triad
groups.def: Triple Threat Triad members shown in the show: leaders Zolt and Viper, Shady Shin, and Mako and Bolin, who "used to do some work for them" as street kids ("The Revelation").

groups.title: Fire Ferrets
groups.def: The Fire Ferrets pro-bending team: Mako, Bolin, their first waterbender Hasook and his replacement Korra, plus the team's mascot Pabu, Bolin's fire ferret, who wears a team uniform at the championship. Bolin's two Book Two teammates aren't in this file.

groups.title: Twins
groups.def: Characters who are one half of a pair of twins.

groups.title: Back from the Original Series
groups.def: Characters from Avatar: The Last Airbender who appear in this show: Katara, Zuko and Toph, now elderly, and Uncle Iroh as a spirit. Bumi, Kya, General Iroh and Wu only share names with original-series characters.

groups.title: Main villain of a Book
groups.def: The main antagonists of the four books: Amon (One), Unalaq and Vaatu, who merge into the Dark Avatar (Two), Zaheer (Three), Kuvira (Four). Secondary villains (Tarrlok, Hiroshi, Varrick, P'Li, Ming-Hua, Ghazan, Baatar Jr.) don't count.

groups.title: Industrialists
groups.def: The heads of the show's two big companies: Hiroshi Sato and Asami (Future Industries) and Varrick with Zhu Li, whom he calls his partner ("We're partners!") and who refuses to be his assistant any more and demands to be treated as his equal ("Kuvira's Gambit"). Engineers without a company (Baatar Jr.) don't count.

groups.title: Animal Companions
groups.def: Named animals (not spirits) who appear in the show: Korra's Naga, Bolin's Pabu, Tenzin's family bison Oogi and Zuko's dragon Druk.

groups.title: Korra's relatives
groups.def: Korra's family: her parents Tonraq and Senna, her uncle Unalaq and her twin cousins Desna and Eska.

groups.title: Debended by Amon
groups.def: Characters whose bending Amon takes away in Book One: Zolt and Shady Shin at the Revelation rally, Tahno, Lin, Tarrlok, and Korra (all but her airbending). Bolin, Mako and Tenzin's family are saved just in time.

groups.title: Died during the show
groups.def: Characters who die during the series' story: Amon and Tarrlok (boat explosion), Unalaq, P'Li, Ming-Hua, Ghazan, Hou-Ting and Hiroshi (Book Four finale). Iroh died before the show; Aiwei is trapped in the Fog of Lost Souls, not killed; Viper's death is comics-only. Destroyed spirits aren't counted, so this group never shares a board with Spirits.

groups.title: Engaged during the show
groups.def: Characters engaged at some point during the show: Bolin and Eska (she ties a betrothal necklace on him in "Civil Wars, Part 2"), Kuvira and Baatar Jr. (engaged throughout Book Four), and Varrick and Zhu Li (he proposes in "Day of the Colossus"). Couples already married before the show began don't count.

groups.title: Gained airbending after Harmonic Convergence
groups.def: Former nonbenders who gain airbending after Harmonic Convergence: Bumi, Kai, Opal and Zaheer. Tenzin, Jinora, Ikki and Meelo were born airbenders, Korra first airbends in Book One and Oogi is a bison.

groups.title: Voiced by Dee Bradley Baker
groups.def: Characters whose main voice in the show is Dee Bradley Baker (wiki voice credits): the animals Naga, Pabu and Oogi, the spirit Bum-Ju, and Tarrlok. Bumi is out: Richard Riehle voices him, and Baker's single yell for him in his Book One cameo ("Endgame") is too obscure to count. Druk has no credited voice, so this group avoids Firebenders.

groups.title: Same name as a different ATLA character
groups.def: Characters whose name is the full name of a different character from the Avatar: The Last Airbender TV series: Bumi (King Bumi), Kya (Katara's mother), General Iroh (named after Uncle Iroh) and Wu (the fortuneteller Aunt Wu). Katara, Zuko, Toph and Uncle Iroh are the original characters themselves; partial matches (Lin/Lin Yee, Ming-Hua/Ming, Wei/Jin Wei) don't count.
